aboutPage.subtitle: Packaging and consumables supply for businesses since 1990

story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: Founded in 1990, Bakırcılar Ambalaj provides wholesale supply services for the packaging and consumable needs of businesses. We bring packaging, cleaning, paper, hygiene, food and office consumables together in one place.
story.paragraph2: Operating from two locations, our company helps businesses manage different product groups through a clear and organized supply process.
story.paragraph3: Brands with which we have supply and dealership relationships include Hayat Kimya, Diversey, Green (İlmak Makina), Kurukahveci Mehmet Efendi, Doğuş Çay and Bencup.

aboutPage.visionDetailed: To provide a clear and accessible corporate service through which businesses can manage different consumable needs in one supply arrangement.
aboutPage.missionDetailed: To bring packaging, cleaning, paper, hygiene, food and office consumables together for businesses through a clear product structure and direct communication.
